evidence: Modifies socket configuration for inbound P2P connections to ensure non-blocking behavior.
rationale: Hardens inbound P2P sockets against potential stalling attacks as a defense-in-depth measure. Existing send and recv calls already mitigate this on POSIX systems by passing MSG_DONTWAIT, so this does not fix an active bug, but it eliminates a hazard where a missed per-call flag could allow a peer to stall I/O indefinitely.
